entries.summary: Created the project and established the first lyrics display, song modal, and repository setup.
Reworked the player and song modal, refined the app layout, and changed the backup import/export flow.
Continued the version 5 lyrics display and song-modal interface work.
Improved artist-name handling and the dynamic background around the song experience.
Built out lyrics utilities and playback/display behavior, with follow-up player and background changes.
Iterated on lyric timing and display behavior, song details, and the first settings controls.
Added transliteration fixes and refined the lyrics view and sync workspace.
Expanded the lyrics display and ad-lib support, with extensive work on song-modal layout and styling.
Improved sync behavior, reduced audio stutter, and worked through mobile layout and performance issues.
Adjusted the sync workspace and song-modal styling.
Overhauled translation and transliteration, added Arabic-script improvements, and refined lyrics and sync displays.
Reworked translation workspace and processing behavior, transliteration, and lyric-line rendering.
Improved focused ad-lib tracking and placement, and added debugging tools for ad-lib layout.
Overhauled the app, settings, navigation, and song-card interface; tested and revised playback optimizations.
Refined song cards and lyric-line rendering, and fixed translation display issues.
Improved split-line lyric rendering and sync behavior, and updated the sample Vault and artist-image manager.
Worked on the player interface, app styling, dynamic backgrounds, and visual controls.
Integrated Deezer playback/source work and refined the player and song details interface.
Updated app navigation and settings, alongside sample-library and layout refinements.
Continued app and lyrics-rendering fixes and worked on the developer blog feature.
Added the public blog article catalogue, improved blog presentation, and continued player, lyrics, and sync refinements.
Added Japanese and Chinese lyric word-spacing work and adjusted lyric glow, shadows, and ad-lib syncing.
Refined sync editing and lyric formatting, including split lines and formatted lyric output.
Improved lyric formatting and translation processing, with updates to the sample Vault.

Refreshed the example Vault data.
Split the lyrics display into smaller components and fixed translation and ad-lib spacing issues.
Tuned ad-lib timing and placement, lyric rendering, and song-data handling.
Continued fixes to lyric formatting, ad-lib tracking, and sync workspace behavior.
Fixed translation and auto-spacing behavior while refining sync workspace interactions.
Worked extensively on CJK lyric formatting and spacing, translation behavior, and diagnostic overlays.
Improved sync responsiveness and translation spacing, and refined the app background.
Adjusted sync workspace behavior and timing logic.
Refined track-grid presentation and in-feed sponsor placement.

Updated the example Vault data.
Improved focused lyrics and equalizer presentation, updated dynamic backgrounds, and fixed lyric-language rendering issues.
Expanded the app experience with blog, contact, and advertising work, plus lyric presentation, artist colors, and ambient background refinements.
Worked on app storage, song data, and performance optimizations, then revised changes to address regressions.
Added audio-delay testing and sync-delay controls, and fixed focused-lyrics playback behavior.
Refined Focused lyrics and song cards; reverted unfinished experiments.
Fixed a bug and security alert; refreshed example Vault data.
Fixed lyric-sync editing and timing; updated sample Vault data.
Added Group Chat lyrics and improved timeline behavior and Focused-view timing.
Overhauled the blog; refined search, song controls, navigation, and lyrics-view transitions.
Polished Group Chat bubbles, avatars, presence, and layout; fixed chat issues.
Refined Group Chat lyrics and responsive layouts; updated the favicon.

Refined the changelog timeline, search, and mobile controls. Added SEO metadata, sitemap coverage, and consent-aware ads. Redesigned homepage and blog artwork, workspace previews, and navigation; polished the favicon and FAQ.

Improved SEO, homepage copy, artwork, and responsive workspace previews. Refined homepage changelog and navigation. Balanced Focused lyrics and translations within measured glyph bounds; improved Live Lyrics ad-lib clearance. Fixed empty Group Chat messages, fitted bubbles to wrapped content, centered notification text and timestamps, and smoothed equalizer animation across frame rates.

Improved homepage previews and mobile navigation. Kept the Vault preview to 12 cards and hid its scrollbar. Fit Live Scroll artwork and auto-followed active lyrics. Added consistent artist colors. Refined Group Chat bubbles, translations, and pronunciation. Put PlanetMusic first in browser and social titles. Refined the Contact hero and moved support and privacy links beside the introduction. Fixed split-ad-lib punctuation crashes. Preserved credits on white gradient ad-libs. Matched wrapped bubbles to lyric and pronunciation bounds. Anchored new Group Chat entries above the typing footer. Glided older rows by arrival height and composited visible chat elements to reduce jitter.
Refined player, Deezer playback, lyrics, and responsive layouts. Added legal pages and improved homepage navigation.

Added selective song export with optional settings. Added Deezer ARL support and blog posts. Improved backup imports with song selection, merge-safe updates, and a guide. Refreshed homepage feature cards, artwork, hero spacing, and the responsive six-step guide. Improved Live Lyrics translations, wrapped-text spacing, ad-lib persistence, and staged rendering. Restored staggered SongCard entrances and smoothed player transitions; SongModal now opens immediately. Expanded product promos with new graphics, Self-Promo badges, varied placement, and rotation. Refined Vault ads and Settings promo layouts for mobile. Made ads default on for new visitors while preserving saved opt-outs. Updated Vault, Ambient, and Zen backgrounds; hid the Zen banner ad. Improved Live Scroll preview smoothness and reduced homepage background chat visibility.

Cached SongCard artwork colors. Delayed player color extraction until playback. Refined CJK lyric alignment. Staged Live Lyrics rendering in small batches. Deferred lyric layout measurements until lines approach the viewport. Smoothed player positioning after SongModal entrance.

Precomputed Live Lyrics measurements; reduced scroll recalculations. Refined wrapped ad-lib glyph, translation, pronunciation alignment. Stabilized measurements before initial SongModal reveal. Kept main pronunciation visible. Prevented mobile player-canvas overlap. Scaled active lines; reduced inactive lines. Tightened inline ad-lib spacing. Aligned main and ad-lib text baselines. Added pronunciation-aware ad-lib positioning. Offset non-foreign ad-libs after foreign lyrics. Kept foreign ad-libs correctly classified. Shifted main lyrics beneath foreign ad-libs. Moved following lyric rows down accordingly. Preserved box dimensions, padding, and animations.
